new_findings.title: Treat reordered all-group selection as a full suite
new_findings.defect: `full_suite` compares selected groups by list order even though `_selected_groups` preserves caller order and group selection is otherwise membership based.
new_findings.failure_scenario: With manifest groups `deterministic` then `browser`, invoking release mode with `groups=["browser", "deterministic"]` executes both groups but sets `full_suite` false, returns status 1, and records `release_evidence` false.
new_findings.fix: Compare selected and available group membership as sets, or normalize selected groups to manifest order before computing `full_suite`.

summary: All five prior corrections hold and the required suite passes (55 tests); one medium release-mode selection-order defect remains because an explicit all-group selection in a different order is rejected as partial.
